baselines.common_temporal: same attention LSTM and training settings as full model

funds.filter: induced graph on explicitly admitted address cohort only; independent assumption pending actual source
funds.status: blocked: exact 65-entity address mapping and historical vintage not recovered

graphwave.approximation: exact sparse matrix exponential actions, capacity failure before unbounded dense materialization
graphwave.heat: matrix exponential on bounded fixtures, sparse approximation must pass oracle
graphwave.readout: real and imaginary empirical characteristic function over heat wavelet column for each scale/time, mean over nodes

node2vec.embedding_alignment: training-only anchor basis; test only aligned to immediately preceding available snapshot
node2vec.loss: skipgram negative-sampling sum positive and five negative logsigmoid terms, mean over positive pairs
node2vec.transition: unweighted weak undirected; isolated walk stops
node2vec.window: fixed symmetric distance<=5; no dynamic window

watchyourstep.batching: exact blockwise pair objective, no negative subsampling
watchyourstep.initialization: normal std0.1 for embeddings; zeros for attention logits
watchyourstep.objective: Eq12 arXiv:1710.09599v2: beta*L2(q)^2 + sum(-E[D]*logsigmoid(LR^T) - indicator(A=0)*logsigmoid(-LR^T)); E[D]=10*I*sum softmax(q)_k*T^k

baselines.graph_alignment: node2vec/WatchYourStep: align successive embeddings with orthogonal Procrustes on common addresses only, no future graph; first orientation fixed by seed. No anchors => unavailable. Mean node pooling. GraphWave coordinates intrinsically fixed by frozen times/scales.

metrics.aggregation: annual metrics averaged equally across seven folds; seed mean/range separately; pooled date results also retained
metrics.zero_division: 0 for undefined precision/recall/F1; MAPE undefined if true price <=0

hlstm.implementation: independent temporal adaptation of Hou et al. 2020 Fig2/Eqs3-4
hlstm.readout: shared lower final state per chunk, upper final state to task head
hlstm.training: common frozen training.json, not Hou cyberattack training settings

svm.classification: SVC C=1 kernel=rbf gamma=scale class_weight=None probability=False tol=0.001 max_iter=-1; sigmoid(decision_function) is uncalibrated diagnostic score, threshold 0
svm.regression: SVR C=1 epsilon=0.1 kernel=rbf gamma=scale tol=0.001 max_iter=-1

uncertainty.missing_daily_runs: unavailable interval until pre-result gap-aware amendment

whales.filter: drop every edge incident to whale, rebuild derived features
whales.threshold: strictly greater than 0.9*max wallet volume within same week
whales.volume: per-week incoming+outgoing native value; self transfer counted twice

dictionary.capacity_action: raise explicit capacity error, no truncation
dictionary.insufficient_samples: explicit unavailable if fewer than dictionary size
dictionary.neighborhood: weak one-hop induced subgraph retaining directed edges and center
dictionary.partition: seeded permutation chunks; min(32,chunk size) medoids each; recursively cluster medoids to 32
dictionary.representative: medoid minimizing within-cluster sum distance; ties sample index
dictionary.sampling: without replacement over (training week,center); equal initial mass per candidate; after selection halve weights of remaining centers inside sampled neighborhood in that week
dictionary.training_scope: only graph snapshots fully available inside training interval

graph.availability: week end + 1 day; retrospective assumption, historical publication unverified

btc_projection.fees: sum(inputs)-sum(outputs), do not allocate as transferred value
btc_projection.missing_prevout: reject as unavailable, no zero fill
btc_projection.non_address_scripts: exclude entire transaction if any input/output cannot map to one address; count
btc_projection.rule: for each resolved address input amount a_i and output b_j: rational a_i*b_j/sum(inputs)

eth_filters.duplicates: reject duplicate transaction identity before filtering

graph.event_universe: confirmed native top-level transfers only; no token logs/internal calls
graph.parallel_edges: aggregate ordered pair: count and sum native value
graph.partial_weeks: exclude with explicit missing-source intervals; never fabricate partial graphs

raw_units.BTC: integer satoshis; rational projection; /1e8 for features

graph.self_loops: retain observed self transfers; GAT adds one self-neighbor

matching.convergence: temperature termination; no additional fixed-point stopping
matching.hardening: greedy global maximum; ties row-major; remove row and column; stop after min(n,m) matches
matching.initialization: node agreement s2 (Algorithm1 s1 symbol corrected by argument type)
matching.objective: paper Eq1 literal including factor 2 in edge denominator
matching.precision_accelerated: float32 output with float64 affinity and annealing
matching.rectangular: un-padded rectangular one-pass normalization; soft row/column sums need not both equal 1; hard assignment must be injective
matching.s1: edge RBF exp(-mean squared feature difference); zero if either edge absent
matching.s2: node RBF exp(-mean squared feature difference)
matching.update: Q_ui=0.5*sum_vj(edge_agreement_uvij*M_vj)+alpha*node_agreement_ui; literal Algorithm1, not claimed Eq2 derivative
matching.zero_edges: edge contribution zero if either graph has zero edges; retain node contribution divided by (1+alpha)
